answer_1.quote: EX2 uses reinforcement learning to align an LLM with VLM preferences and generates descriptions that incorporate features that are important for the VLM.
answer_1.outputs: Concept descriptions generated by the LLM

answer_2.quote: we use the 25 generated descriptions for each concept as a prompt ensemble and use cosine similarity to predict the label for each image.

answer_3.quote: We use ChatGPT to automatically inspect the large number of descriptions.
methods: Prompt-based classification for informative and visual attributes

answer_4.quote: We also do a manual evaluation of the quality of ChatGPT inspections and get reasonable results.
answer_4.guideline: Manual inspection to check if descriptions are informative and contain visual attributes.
